spec: REC — Real-time Event Capture: Autonomous AI Photography System

features.description: Monorepo scaffold: edge-node, cloud-api, portal, and shared packages directories exist with package.json in each
Docker Compose file defines all services: camera-controller, detection-engine, capture-orchestrator, api-gateway, embedding-worker, postgres, redis, minio, portal
PostgreSQL with pgvector extension initializes on first run with all schema tables (events, cameras, images, face_embeddings, face_clusters, portal_users)
MinIO object storage starts and auto-creates the 'rec-images' bucket on first run
steps: mc alias set local http://localhost:9000 && mc ls local/

features.description: Redis starts and is reachable; Celery worker connects and reports healthy
init.sh bootstrap script starts entire stack (edge + cloud) with a single command and prints all service URLs
Environment variable template (.env.example) covers all required secrets: DB_URL, MINIO_KEY, REDIS_URL, JWT_SECRET, MINIO_BUCKET
Prometheus + Grafana start and Prometheus can scrape the api-gateway /metrics endpoint
CameraDriver abstract base class defined with connect, get_live_preview_frame, trigger_autofocus, capture_image, set_aperture, set_iso, set_shutter_speed, move_ptz methods
steps: Raises NotImplementedError on move_ptz for non-PTZ

features.description: DSLRDriver (gPhoto2) implements CameraDriver: connect() detects USB camera via gphoto2 --auto-detect and returns True/False
steps: python -c 'from camera.dslr import DSLRDriver; d=DSLRDriver(); print(d.connect())'

features.description: DSLRDriver.get_live_preview_frame() returns a numpy ndarray (BGR) from the camera LiveView stream
DSLRDriver.trigger_autofocus() sends autofocusdrive config widget and polls for AF confirmation within 500ms timeout; returns True on success
DSLRDriver.capture_image() triggers GP_CAPTURE_IMAGE, downloads the file to local buffer, and returns CapturedImage with filepath, timestamp, camera_id
PTZDriver (ONVIF) implements CameraDriver.connect() by discovering camera via wsdiscovery and authenticating via WS-Security digest auth
steps: connect() returns True on valid credentials

features.description: PTZDriver.move_ptz(pan, tilt, zoom) sends ONVIF ContinuousMove command with correct velocity vector; clamps inputs to [-1, 1]
steps: Unit test: values outside range are clamped

features.description: PTZDriver.move_ptz raises NotSupported on DSLRDriver; DSLRDriver.move_ptz raises NotImplementedError correctly
CameraManager singleton manages multiple simultaneous CameraDriver instances keyed by camera_id; supports add_camera, remove_camera, get_camera, list_cameras
steps: Unit test: add 3 cameras, list returns 3 ids

features.description: Camera auto-reconnect loop: if USB disconnects, DSLRDriver retries connect() with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s max) and logs each attempt
steps: Unit test: simulate 3 failed connects then success

features.description: YOLOv8n model loads successfully and runs inference on a test image, returning detections filtered to person class only (class index 0)
steps: python -c 'from detection.yolo_detector import YOLODetector; d=YOLODetector(); print(d.detect(test_frame))'

features.description: NanoDet-Plus model loads as CPU fallback; PersonDetector factory returns YOLODetector on CUDA and NanoDetDetector on CPU-only
steps: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' python -c 'from detection.factory import get_detector; print(type(get_detector()))'

features.description: PersonDetection dataclass has bbox, confidence, centroid, bbox_area, frame_fill_ratio, timestamp, camera_id fields; centroid is auto-computed from bbox
steps: Unit test: create PersonDetection with bbox=(10,10,110,210)

features.description: Detection confidence threshold filter: detections with confidence < 0.45 are discarded; threshold is configurable via constructor arg
steps: Unit test with mock model returning confidence 0.3 and 0.7

features.description: Frame skipping: detector processes every Nth frame (default N=2); skipped frames return previous frame's detections via cache
steps: Unit test: call detect() 4 times with N=2

features.description: ROI masking: detector accepts an optional mask ndarray; pixels outside mask are zeroed before inference to ignore static background regions
steps: Unit test: mask covers top half

features.description: Resolution downscaling: detector resizes input frame to 640x480 before inference, then maps bbox coordinates back to original frame dimensions
steps: Output bboxes are in 1920x1080 coordinate space

features.description: DetectionEngine class wraps the detector, reads frames from CameraDriver, and emits PersonDetection lists at >= 15 FPS via an async queue
steps: Integration test: run engine for 2 seconds

features.description: AppearanceSignature dataclass contains deep_embedding (512-dim ndarray), upper_body_color_hist (48-dim), lower_body_color_hist (48-dim), body_aspect_ratio, estimated_height_class, last_known_position, last_known_camera, last_seen_timestamp, confidence, update_count
steps: Unit test: instantiate with all fields

features.description: AppearanceExtractor.extract() returns None for frames where frame_idx % extraction_interval != 0 (default interval=5)
steps: Unit test: call extract() 10 times with frame_idx 0..9
Returns non-None only on frames 0 and 5

features.description: AppearanceExtractor extracts OSNet x0.25 deep embedding: loads model on GPU if available, falls back to CPU; output is L2-normalized 512-dim vector
AppearanceExtractor._compute_hsv_histogram() returns 48-dim L2-normalized array from an HSV color histogram (16 hue x 3 saturation bins)
AppearanceExtractor splits person crop at midpoint: upper half used for upper_body_color_hist (shirt), lower half for lower_body_color_hist (pants)
steps: Unit test: red top, blue bottom crop

features.description: IdentityMatcher.compute_similarity() returns MatchResult with composite score = 0.55*deep + 0.20*color + 0.10*body + 0.15*spatial; is_match=True when composite >= 0.60
IdentityMatcher._spatial_plausibility() returns 0.1 when time_gap < 0; returns 1.0 when same camera and person has not moved; returns 0.1 when pixel distance exceeds max_plausible distance
GlobalIdentityLedger.register_or_match() creates a new PID when no gallery entry scores >= 0.60; returns the new PID string
steps: Unit test: empty gallery + new signature

features.description: GlobalIdentityLedger.register_or_match() returns existing PID when best match score >= 0.60; does NOT create a duplicate identity
steps: Unit test: register same person twice

features.description: GlobalIdentityLedger._update_identity() applies EMA (alpha=0.85) to deep_embedding and color histograms; re-normalizes embedding after blend
GlobalIdentityLedger persists camera_seen_on set: after seeing person on camera-A then camera-B, cameras_seen_on == {'camera-A', 'camera-B'}
steps: Unit test: two register_or_match calls from different cameras

features.description: CoverageFairnessEngine.should_capture() returns allowed=False when identity.capture_count >= MAX_TOTAL_CAPTURES (20)
CoverageFairnessEngine.should_capture() returns allowed=False for solo mode when solo capture count >= MAX_SOLO_CAPTURES (8)
CoverageFairnessEngine.should_capture() returns allowed=False during adaptive cooldown: cooldown = 15 * (1 + 0.5 * count) seconds
CoverageFairnessEngine.should_capture() returns priority=1.0 (PRIORITY BOOST) for identity with capture_count < 50% of average
CoverageFairnessEngine.get_priority_queue() returns PIDs sorted by priority descending; new persons (not in ledger) always get priority 1.0
CoverageFairnessEngine.compute_gini_coefficient() returns 0.0 for uniform distribution and 1.0 for single-person monopoly
CoverageFairnessEngine.should_capture() returns priority=0.3 (low) for a group combination already captured (frozenset of PIDs already in group_combinations_captured)
steps: Unit test: same duo captured twice

features.description: Full PIS integration: 10 simulated persons enter and leave frame randomly over 60 simulated seconds; final Gini coefficient <= 0.35

CaptureOrchestrator state machine transitions: SCANNING -> EVALUATING on person detection, EVALUATING -> FOCUSING on composition pass, FOCUSING -> CAPTURING on AF confirm, CAPTURING -> COOLDOWN, COOLDOWN -> SCANNING
steps: Unit test: feed detection events in sequence

features.description: ShutterTimingEngine.is_ready() returns WAIT_MOTION when centroid_velocity > 15px; WAIT_STABILITY when stable_frame_count < 5; WAIT_CLOSER when face_height < 80px; FIRE otherwise
steps: Correct ShutterDecision enum returned per condition

features.description: Capture mode selector: returns SOLO for 1 person fill 0.15-0.60, DUO for 2 proximate, TRIO for 3, GROUP for 4+, CANDID for back-facing, INTERACTION for mutual-facing pair
steps: Unit test each mode trigger condition

features.description: PTZ PID controller: given centroid error (ex, ey), outputs ONVIF velocity within [-0.5, 0.5]; dead zone 0.05 produces zero output; Kp=0.4, Ki=0.01, Kd=0.1
Auto-zoom for PTZ: compute_zoom_command() returns 0 when fill ratio within 5% of target 0.35; positive when fill < 0.30; negative when fill > 0.40
Orchestrator integrates PIS: before capture decision, calls CoverageFairnessEngine.should_capture(PID, mode, group); skips capture if allowed=False
Orchestrator picks highest-priority PID from CoverageFairnessEngine.get_priority_queue() when multiple persons visible; camera frames/focuses on highest-priority subject

On successful capture, orchestrator records: identity.capture_count++, identity.last_capture_time=now, identity.capture_modes_used.add(mode), identity.group_combinations_captured.add(group_combo) for group shots
Stage 1: blur_score() computes Laplacian variance; returns float; score < threshold means REJECT; threshold configurable (DSLR=120, mirrorless=80, PTZ=50)
steps: Unit test: sharp test image -> score > 120

features.description: Stage 2: face_presence() uses RetinaFace (InsightFace) to detect faces; REJECT if zero faces detected, or all faces have height < 60px, or all have det_score < 0.7
Stage 3: aesthetic_score() runs NIMA MobileNetV2 model and returns mean aesthetic score (0-10); REJECT if score < 4.5
steps: Unit test: known high-quality portrait image -> score >= 4.5

features.description: Stage 4: smart_crop() detects faces via RetinaFace, positions face at nearest rule-of-thirds intersection, pads 15% around outermost face, never crops at neck/wrist/elbow joints, returns (x,y,w,h) crop box
steps: Crop shifts face to upper-third intersection

features.description: IQGPipeline.run() executes all 4 stages in sequence, short-circuits on first REJECT, returns IQGResult(passed=bool, stage=str, score=float, crop_box=tuple)
steps: passed=False, stage='blur', pipeline stops at stage 1

features.description: IQGPipeline produces output crops in all 5 aspect ratios (4:5, 3:2, 1:1, 9:16, native) for passed images; each stored with a suffix in filename
IQGPipeline.run() is idempotent: running the same image twice produces identical IQGResult (no side effects, no DB writes inside)
steps: Unit test: run same image twice

features.description: FaceDetector (RetinaFace/InsightFace) detects all faces in an image and returns list of FaceDetection(bbox, landmarks_5pt, det_score) sorted by det_score descending
FaceAligner applies affine transform using 5-point landmarks to produce a 112x112 aligned face chip, normalized to RGB float32 in [-1, 1]
AuraFaceEmbedder loads AuraFace v1 (Apache 2.0) weights, runs on aligned face chip, returns L2-normalized 512-dim float32 vector; cosine similarity of same face >= 0.85
Embedding quality filter: rejects face if det_score < 0.80, face height < 60px, yaw_angle > 45 degrees, or occlusion score above threshold

FaceEmbeddingPipeline.process(image_id) loads image from storage, runs detect->align->embed for each qualified face, returns list of EmbeddingResult(face_index, embedding, bbox, landmarks, det_score, yaw_angle)
EmbeddingResult is persisted to face_embeddings table with correct schema (id, image_id, face_index, embedding VECTOR(512), bbox jsonb, det_score, yaw_angle, created_at)
HNSW index on face_embeddings.embedding created at migration time: CREATE INDEX ... USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (m=16, ef_construction=200)
steps: hnsw index present on embedding column

features.description: batch_cluster(event_id) fetches all embeddings for an event, runs DBSCAN(eps=0.45, min_samples=2, metric=cosine), assigns cluster UUIDs as face_clusters rows, updates face_embeddings.cluster_id for all members
steps: Integration test: 20 embeddings from 5 distinct people

features.description: assign_to_cluster(new_embedding, event_id) computes centroid of each existing cluster, finds best cosine similarity; if >= 0.55 assigns to that cluster; else creates new cluster
steps: Unit test: embedding from known person

features.description: Cluster centroid updates after assign_to_cluster: centroid = mean of all member embeddings, re-normalized; stored in face_clusters.centroid VECTOR(512)
steps: Unit test: add 3 embeddings to cluster

features.description: Celery task run_full_clustering(event_id) is idempotent: running twice produces same cluster assignments (no duplicate clusters created)
steps: Integration test: run task twice on same data
face_clusters count unchanged after second run

features.description: face_clusters.representative_face_id points to the embedding with highest det_score within the cluster (best quality face)
steps: Integration test: cluster with 5 faces, mixed det_scores
representative_face_id matches the row with max det_score

features.description: POST /api/v1/events creates event; requires name, venue, start_time; returns 201 with event UUID; rejects missing fields with 422 and field-level errors
steps: curl POST with valid body -> 201 + UUID

features.description: GET /api/v1/events/{id} returns event details; returns 404 with JSON error when event does not exist
steps: GET existing event -> 200 with event JSON

features.description: POST /api/v1/events/{id}/cameras registers a camera (type, model, connection_type, location_label, config); returns 201 with camera UUID
POST /api/v1/cameras/{id}/start starts auto-capture on the camera; returns 200; triggers DetectionEngine and CaptureOrchestrator startup in background thread
POST /api/v1/cameras/{id}/stop stops auto-capture; returns 200; camera status returns to 'connected'
GET /api/v1/events/{id}/images returns paginated list of IQG-passed images (page, limit params); response includes image_id, capture_mode, thumbnail_url, captured_at
steps: GET images page=1 limit=10 -> 200 with items array
next_page present when more images exist

features.description: GET /api/v1/images/{id}/download returns a presigned MinIO URL (or stream) for the full-resolution image; returns 404 for unknown image_id
steps: GET valid image -> 200 or redirect to signed URL

features.description: GET /api/v1/events/{id}/stats returns: total_images, images_passed_iqg, total_faces_embedded, total_pids_identified, gini_coefficient, per_camera_counts
All API endpoints require JWT Bearer auth; missing/invalid/expired tokens return 401; valid token decodes user_id and role
POST /api/v1/auth/login accepts email + password; returns access_token (15min JWT) + refresh_token (7d); invalid credentials return 401
GET /api/v1/cameras/{id}/status returns camera_type, status, fps, capture_count, last_capture_time, current_pid_count, gini_coefficient; updates in real-time
steps: GET camera status while capturing -> 200 with live metrics

features.description: FastAPI /metrics endpoint exposes Prometheus metrics: api_requests_total, api_latency_seconds, captures_total, iqg_pass_rate, embedding_queue_depth
POST /api/v1/events/{id}/match accepts multipart selfie upload; validates it is an image file <= 10MB; returns 400 for non-image or oversized files
steps: POST valid JPEG -> proceeds to matching

features.description: POST /api/v1/events/{id}/match runs face detection on uploaded selfie; returns 422 with 'no_face_detected' if no face found or det_score < 0.7
steps: POST selfie with no face -> 422 no_face_detected

features.description: POST /api/v1/events/{id}/match generates AuraFace embedding from selfie, searches face_embeddings with HNSW cosine ANN (threshold=0.55, top_k=500), returns matches sorted by similarity descending
steps: POST selfie for known person in test event

features.description: Match response includes for each match: image_id, similarity, thumbnail_url, download_url, capture_mode, captured_at; total_matches and processing_time_ms at root level
steps: All 7 fields present per match item

features.description: POST /api/v1/events/{id}/register saves display_name, selfie path, selfie_embedding, matched_cluster_id for a portal user; returns user UUID
Portal web app: landing page shows event name, QR code description, and 'Find My Photos' call-to-action button; loads without JS errors
Portal web app: selfie capture screen uses MediaDevices.getUserMedia (front camera preferred); captured frame previewed before submission
Portal web app: after successful match, shows masonry gallery of matched photos with similarity badge, download button per photo; empty state if no matches
Portal web app: download button generates presigned URL and triggers browser download of full-resolution image
Portal consent flow: before selfie capture, user must check consent checkbox; submit button disabled until checked; consent timestamp stored in portal_users
Celery task process_captured_image(image_id) runs IQG pipeline; on REJECT writes iqg_passed=False + rejection_reason to DB; on PASS writes iqg_passed=True + all scores
steps: Integration test: enqueue task for blurry image

features.description: Celery task process_captured_image on IQG pass runs FaceEmbeddingPipeline.process(); stores all qualified EmbeddingResults; then calls assign_to_cluster() per embedding
steps: Integration test: enqueue task for clear face image

features.description: Celery task process_captured_image has max_retries=3; retries with exponential backoff on transient errors (DB connection lost, MinIO timeout); raises on permanent errors
steps: Unit test: simulate DB failure x2 then success

features.description: Images are uploaded to MinIO with key pattern: {event_id}/{camera_id}/{YYYYMMDD}/{capture_mode}/{uuid}.jpg; thumbnails at same path with _thumb suffix at 640px longest edge
Celery beat schedules run_full_clustering(event_id) every 5 minutes for active events; does not schedule for completed/archived events

Edge node local buffer: captured images saved to /capture-buffer/{camera_id}/{uuid}.jpg; uploader thread picks files from buffer and enqueues process_captured_image task; removes local file on successful enqueue
steps: Integration test: create test image in buffer

features.description: End-to-end smoke test: start full stack via init.sh, inject 5 test frames with a known person, verify >= 1 image appears in /api/v1/events/{id}/images after 30 seconds
Selfie match e2e: inject 10 frames of person A and 10 of person B; register person A via /match selfie; verify only person A's images are in results (0 person B images)
steps: All returned images contain person A
No person B images in results

features.description: Re-ID consistency e2e: person A exits frame for 10 seconds then re-enters; verify PID is the same before and after re-entry; capture_count accumulates correctly
Coverage fairness e2e: inject 50 frames with 5 distinct people appearing at equal frequency; final Gini coefficient from /api/v1/events/{id}/stats <= 0.35
Performance: detection engine achieves >= 15 FPS on a 1280x720 video feed with YOLOv8n on target hardware (NVIDIA RTX 3060 or equivalent)
Performance: selfie match (ANN search) completes in <= 3 seconds p95 for an event with 30,000 face embeddings
All unit tests pass with pytest: edge-node (camera, detection, pis, orchestrator, iqg) and cloud-api (embedding, clustering, api) test suites show 0 failures
